_note: One JSON object per line. Each record confirms/refutes an uncertainty from canonical-sources/uncertainty_ledger.jsonl. Fields: uncertainty_id (must match a ledger entry), decision ('confirmed'|'refuted'), resolution_note, winning_citation, decided_by, decided_ref. At build time build_db.py stamps the ledger entry's status and re-derives dependent fields (confirmed -> needs_confirmation=0). Lines without an uncertainty_id (like this one) are ignored. No wall-clock timestamps (deterministic, committed).
